text:
cheng: Heads up — prepping a dep bump + lockfile sweep for the next release. Need owners for submodule updates and vendor bumps. Planning freeze Thu 09:00 PT. Who can own the submodule PRs?

natalie: I can take tools/infra submodule. Will open the PR today (small sha update).

sam: I'll own vendor/quant + onnx bumps. Will run full unit suite on dedicated after PR.

alex: I'll handle the changelog nudge and release notes. @natalie please drop the PR link here when you have it.

jessica: FYI mac CI flakes with the last vendor bump — saw failures in build.sh and liblink. I'll triage if it repros. :thinking_face:

merge-bot: merge-bot: merge queue hold placed on branch release/v1.3 until lockfile sweep completes.

cheng: Quick checklist for owners: 
```
# update submodule locally
git submodule update --init --recursive
cd third_party/infra && git fetch origin && git checkout <new-sha> && cd -
# refresh vendored libs
./scripts/vendor_sync.sh
# run the smoke suite on dedicated
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --dedicated
```

cheng: Please tag PRs with `release-candidate` and add 2 reviewers. QA: @qa-bot can you kick off smoke runs after PRs are created?

qa-bot: qa-bot: scheduled smoke runs triggered for PR #432 and PR #433 — ETA ~30m each. I'll post results here.

natalie: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood/infra/compare/infra-sha-update — tiny bump, no code changes otherwise. Local CI green.

sam: Quant bump PR: https://github.com/redwood/vendor/compare/quant-bump — running unit tests now, will revert if any regressions.

jessica: On the mac flakes — likely needs a fallback linker flag. If PR causes build failures I'll add a patch and ping here. :wrench:

cheng: If anyone needs to rollback a lockfile bump, call it in this thread and I'll coordinate reverting the merge and cutting a patch branch.

alex: Reminder for changelog: add a 'Dependency updates' section with short bullets per submodule/vendor and note any runtime/behavioural impact.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll add notes about the quant precision change and the compat comment.

cheng: Plan recap: owners open PRs today, QA runs will verify on dedicated, merge-bot hold lifted only after green + smoke pass. Branch freeze Thu 09:00 PT. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
